justification: A lot partly in a flood area read No. Standard not critical: one SQL text, measured on prod read-only, value layers untouched.

pre_impl.existing_data: spatial_overlays (all MULTIPOLYGON, GIST on geom) and nsw_cadastre_lots (GIST on geom)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: No lot covers the point: marker row reads false and the route marks spatial_overlays not checked
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Every lookup from deploy onward; no stored rows change

functions.name: GET property route overlay block
functions.input: address longitude and latitude in WGS84
functions.output: rows of layer_type and value feeding constraints
functions.if_none: no rows means no overlay flags, same as before

queries.purpose: overlay layers at the point plus hazard layers over the whole lot
queries.where_clause: ST_Contains(o.geom, point) OR (lot found AND ST_Intersects(o.geom, lot) AND overlap > 1 m2) for the listed layer types
queries.if_wrong: A neighbour's polygon sharing only an edge would count; blocked by the 1 m2 overlap rule

break_it.scenario: Address point outside a flood polygon that covers the back of the lot
break_it.what_happens: Before: no flood flag. Now: flood flag

break_it.scenario: A neighbouring FSR polygon touches the lot edge
break_it.what_happens: Would add a second FSR value and pick the wrong one
break_it.how: Value layers are not in the lot branch; test_value_layers_stay_at_the_point

break_it.scenario: The lot union query is slow on a large lot
break_it.what_happens: The lookup budget runs out and overlays read not checked
break_it.how: Measured 40 to 120 ms on prod with both GIST indexes used

falsifiable_check.observed_red: Ran against prod read-only with the SQL moved but unchanged: flood missed on all 3 real lots; 3 failed, 3 passed.
